content.short: Faraland is a strategic, turn-based fantasy RPG on Binance Smart Chain where players earn crypto rewards and trade on-chain NFTs.
content.description: Faraland is a popular play-to-earn fantasy RPG built on the Binance Smart Chain, offering a rich, PvP-focused experience. The game delivers a turn-based combat experience in which players can earn crypto rewards by defeating other players in PvP battles. Across the Faraland universe, every character and item is represented as an on-chain NFT, enabling free trading within the Faraland marketplace. The project was founded by Moon Knight Labs in September 2020.
